goal: The feed will shift to about 69 wt % ethylene and the unit needs about 25 % more ethylene from this tower at polymer-grade purity. Find what limits the tower, propose the change, and make the design pass every engineering check, including the documented product purity spec (ethane in the ethylene product at most 0.1 wt %) and the +10 % feed operating envelope.
